metrics.scope: supplement16 engineering smoke only; one test scene; no formal collection, quota occupancy, or training permission

_meta.name: diag_g01_s16_smoke_plan_01
command:
"""Explicit original-quota derivative for the one authorized engineering scene.
No source/scientific inventory is accepted here; GPU parent reauthenticates the
unchanged confirmed configuration basis after its real render gate.
"""
import copy,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.g01_quota_plan import load_plan,validate_structure
from src.tools.g01_physics_smoke import validate_quota,SCOPE
NAME='diag_g01_s16_smoke_plan_01'
PARENT='gen_test_s16_smoke_01'
SOURCE={'file':'configs/gen_test_config_round2_40_s01_retry2_quota.json',
        'sha256':'2bb1fd9d91723a591b2784ae7f243501d5e521302f04624c9a57670b03af7afe'}
OUT='configs/gen_test_s16_smoke_01_quota.json'
assert not Path('results',NAME+'.json').exists() and not Path(OUT).exists()
original,_,_=load_plan(SOURCE,authenticate=False)
assert original['parent_run_name']=='gen_test_config_round2_40_s01_retry2'
plan=copy.deepcopy(original)
plan['parent_run_name']=PARENT
plan['assignments']=[row for row in original['assignments'] if row['scene']=='FloorPlan21']
plan['engineering_smoke_authorization']={'version':'g01_s16_single_scene_600s_v1',
    'original_quota_reference':SOURCE,'scene_timeout_seconds':600,
    'formal_collection_eligible':False,'quota_occupancy_authorized':False,'scope':SCOPE}
validate_structure(plan);validate_quota(plan,PARENT)
with Path(OUT).open('x') as stream:json.dump(plan,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False);stream.write('\n')
Path(OUT).chmod(0o444)
ref={'file':OUT,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(OUT).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
metrics={'status':'engineering_smoke_plan_ready','quota_reference':ref,'source_quota_reference':SOURCE,
    'scene':'FloorPlan21','scene_grant_seconds':600,'parent_seconds':1000,'pbs_seconds':1030,
    'formal_collection_eligible':False,'quota_occupancy_authorized':False,
    'count_basis_reauthenticated_here':False,'scope':SCOPE}
Path('results',NAME+'.json').write_text(json.dumps({'config':{'name':NAME,'original_quota_reference':SOURCE},
    'metrics':metrics},indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print('G01_S16_SMOKE_QUOTA_JSON: '+json.dumps(plan,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
print('FINAL_METRICS_JSON: '+json.dumps(metrics,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False))
